title: AesCode: Aesthetic Code Generation with Decoupled Cross-Modal Rewards
abstract: Generating information-rich visual artifacts such as slides, posters, and dashboards as code is appealing because the outputs are structured, editable, and verifiable. Yet code models cannot see how their choices of layout and color come together on the canvas, often limiting spatial planning and aesthetic quality. Image generators excel at visual design but can misrender requested content, making their outputs unreliable targets for direct reproduction. We therefore introduce AesCode, which generates code grounded in the content prompt while using an image generated from the same prompt as an aesthetic guidance. To do so, AesCode represents the target as a design graph that describes the whole canvas and makes each property attributable. From this graph, we derive complementary cross-modal rewards: deterministic verifiers score properties parsable from code and rendering, while a VLM judge assesses the non-parsable ones with a sample-specific Visual Graph Rubric (VGR) tied to graph elements and relations. We optimize these decoupled rewards through reinforcement learning with per-channel normalization to jointly improve spatial planning, aesthetic quality, and verifiable correctness. To evaluate this setting, we build a benchmark that scores verifiable correctness and visual quality separately, with visual scores highly consistent with human judgments. We find that reference images substantially improve the visual quality of code generated by existing models, and ablations show that AesCode benefits from references both as model input and as a source of visual rewards. Relative to same-scale Qwen3-VL baselines given the same references, AesCode-8B and AesCode-32B improve visual quality by 31.1 and 22.4 percentage points, reaching scores comparable to those of closed-source frontier models such as GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.18860v1 的 44 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：available。
analysis.ideaZh: AesCode 把 prompt requirements 与非权威生成参考转成 design graph，拆成 DOM/OCR/geometry verifier 和 graph-bound VLM rubric，再分别归一化 reward 做 RL。作者报告 32B Rule94.33、Visual77.44，关键价值是可迁移到结构化设计的监督分解；输出 HTML/CSS 的训练方法，尚无 iterative correction agent。
analysis.motivationZh: 图像参考美观但内容可错，直接 screenshot matching 奖励会复制错误；code 生成又难在文本正确性和视觉质量之间平衡。
analysis.methodZh: graph 节点含 text/chart/table/container，属性含内容、几何、风格，边含 containment/alignment/order 等；policy 输入 prompt+reference，graph 仅监督。六类确定 verifier 加 Visual Graph Rubric 形成七 reward；SFT 后 GDPO per-channel normalization。训练用 synthetic image reference，最终评估只以 prompt-derived checklist 而非 reference similarity。
methodFlow: prompt 与 generated reference 构建 target design graph
render 并从 code/DOM/OCR/pixels 解析 candidate graph
六种 verifier 与 graph-bound visual rubric 分渠道评分
SFT 后 GDPO 分渠道归一化更新
独立 prompt checklist 评估内容与视觉
analysis.experimentsZh: 18K design pool，3K teacher SFT、约8K RL prompts，Qwen3-VL 8B/32B；300 infographic test，每 prompt 3 generations；另 SlidesBench、Design2Code、GDB/lica；prompt-derived visual checklist 与盲评。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告 32B Overall61.10→85.89、Visual55.02→77.44；8B Overall51.93→82.94。（Table1 p.7）；作者报告 full GDPO Visual75.80，scalar GRPO70.68，direct rubric72.61，去 VGR68.12。（Table4 p.9） 对照范围：prompt-only 与 reference-conditioned frontier/open models 分列；外部图形/slide/screenshot tasks；不是同数据训练所有 baselines，图像参考额外成本要计入。 消融与诊断：reference train/inference、SFT/RL、GDPO、layout/whitespace、CLIP/holistic/direct-rubric；支持 graph-bound scoring 和 channel separation；不是闭环迭代收益。
analysis.insightZh: 图像生成器作为 aesthetic teacher，graph 分解约束避免把参考当 ground truth；GDPO 为已有算法，创新在监督和视觉/结构 reward 组织。
analysis.evidenceZh: prompt content 与 reference cues 分属 graph 的可归因约束。（Sec.3.1 pp.3–4; Fig.2 p.4）；六 deterministic verifiers 和 VGR 用独立 channel normalization。（Sec.3.2–3.3 p.5）；同 backbone ablation 与外部任务检验监督迁移。（Tables1–4 pp.7–9）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 主要贡献为 editable structured 2D visual design 的训练与验证，可迁移 graphic programs/SVG 的 reward design；不限于网页 UI。
analysis.caveatZh: 仍有 overflow、关系边丢失、语义 icon 退化成 generic marks（Fig.5 p.10）。；judge pipeline 与 policy reward 共享设计偏好，human validation 只抽样。；结构 verifier 可给遮挡 chart 高分，最终可见性还靠 visual judge。；HTML/CSS/ECharts 约束未证明任意 SVG path/Embroidery 或 native design files 泛化。
